Usage: actual payees [options] [command]

Manage payees

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  list                   List all payees
  common                 List frequently used payees
  create [options]       Create a new payee
  update [options] <id>  Update a payee
  delete <id>            Delete a payee
  merge [options]        Merge payees into a target payee
  help [command]         display help for command
